artifacts.synopsis: TE John Evans appealed Arizona Presbytery's vote to divest him of his office without censure under BCO 34-10, after he had already affiliated with the Evangelical Presbyterian Church in England and Wales and notified the Presbytery of his withdrawal. The SJC unanimously sustained the appeal and reversed the Presbytery's action, holding that Evans had withdrawn from Presbytery's jurisdiction under BCO 38-3a before the divestiture proceedings began, and instructed the Presbytery to record the irregularity, acknowledge his new membership, and remove his name from the roll.

artifacts.synopsis: The SJC sustained a complaint finding that Central Florida Presbytery erred in ruling that Ms. Gendy lacked standing to complain about her removal from church membership under BCO 38-4, holding that a member facing removal retains standing to challenge that removal. The case was remanded to Presbytery to consider the original complaint regarding whether the Session had properly applied BCO 38-3a and 38-4.

artifacts.title: Presbytery's investigative duty when a new body holds evangelical beliefs

matches.evidence: The CCB advised that a presbytery's BCO 2-2 inquiry ends once it concludes a newly formed entity holds a fairly traditional evangelical set of beliefs.
